svg.title: Deterministic simulation: one seed drives a simulated clock, an object store with seeded faults, and actors such as writers, garbage collection and snapshot expiry. They exercise the real commit path, and an oracle checks invariants after every step. A failing run prints its seed, so it can be replayed exactly.
svg.text: a failure prints its seed: replay it exactly

figure.figcaption: Everything that can vary comes from the seed, so every failure can be replayed.
